title: ScheduledMessage

content.description: Text content of the scheduled message

rrule.description: Recurrence rule for recurring scheduled messages, e.g. 'FREQ=MONTHLY' or 'FREQ=WEEKLY;INTERVAL=2'; see [RFC2445](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc2445#section-4.3.10).

timezone_id.description: Timezone ID used to compute times for recurring messages; see [List of tz database time zones Wikipedia article](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones).

recipients.description:
List of recipients. Each recipient is an object with a string `type` property, which may be `"phone_number"`, `"group"`, or `"filter"`.

 If the type is `"phone_number"`, the `phone_number` property will be set to the recipient's phone number.

 If the type is `"group"`, the `group_id` property will be set to the ID of the group, and the `group_name` property will be set to the name of the group.

 If the type is `"filter"`, the `filter_type` property (string) and `filter_params` property (object) describe the filter used to send the broadcast. (API clients should not rely on a particular value or format of the `filter_type` or `filter_params` properties, as they may change without notice.)

recipients_str.description: A string with a human readable description of the first few recipients (possibly truncated)

group_id.description: ID of the group to send the message to (null if the recipient is an individual contact, or if there are multiple recipients)

contact_id.description: ID of the contact to send the message to (null if the recipient is a group, or if there are multiple recipients)

to_number.description: Phone number to send the message to (null if the recipient is a group, or if there are multiple recipients)

route_id.description: ID of the phone or route the message will be sent from

service_id.description: The service associated with this message (for voice calls, the service defines the call flow)

audio_url.description: For voice calls, the URL of an MP3 file to play when the contact answers the call

tts_lang.description: For voice calls, the language of the text-to-speech voice

tts_voice.description: For voice calls, the text-to-speech voice

time_created.description: Time the scheduled message was created in Telerivet

start_time.description: The time that the message will be sent (or first sent for recurring messages)

end_time.description: Time after which a recurring message will stop (not applicable to non-recurring scheduled messages)

prev_time.description: The most recent time that Telerivet has sent this scheduled message (null if it has never been sent)

next_time.description: The next upcoming time that Telerivet will sent this scheduled message (null if it will not be sent again)

occurrences.description: Number of times this scheduled message has already been sent

replace_variables.description: Set to true if Telerivet will render variables like [[contact.name]] in the message content, false otherwise

track_clicks.description: If true, URLs in the message content will automatically be replaced with unique short URLs

url.description: URL of the media file. Note: For files stored by Telerivet (including uploaded files and incoming media attachments), the URL is temporary and may not be valid for more than 1 day.

type.description: MIME type of the media file

file_id.description: ID of the stored file, if applicable

media.description: Array of media attachments for the text message. This property is undefined for messages that do not contain media files.

route_params.description:
Route-specific parameters to use when sending the message. 

 When sending messages via chat apps such as WhatsApp, the route_params parameter can be used to send messages with app-specific features such as quick replies and link buttons.

 For more details, see Route-Specific Parameters.

vars.description:
Custom variables stored for this scheduled message (copied to Message when sent). Variable names may be up to 32 characters in length and can contain the characters a-z, A-Z, 0-9, and _.
 Values may be strings, numbers, or boolean (true/false).
 String values may be up to 4096 bytes in length when encoded as UTF-8.
 Up to 100 variables are supported per object.
 Setting a variable to null will delete the variable.

label_ids.description: IDs of labels to add to the Message

relative_scheduled_id.description: ID of the relative scheduled message this scheduled message was created from, if applicable

project_id.description: ID of the project this scheduled message belongs to

is_template.description: Set to true if Telerivet will render variables like [[contact.name]] in the message content

description: Represents a scheduled message within Telerivet.
